descriptions.base: Tokens, paper stocks, pens, frames, the appearance runtime, FinelinerDefs, cn and the pen's seed and filters. Every other item builds on it; make src/fineliner/styles/fineliner.css your Tailwind entry.
descriptions.pen: The pen engine, framework-free: seeded strokes, shapes and sheets, the object library with every collection, scenes, lettering and pen marks, as SVG strings on a server, at build time or in the browser.
descriptions.drawing: Drawing, Lettering and PenMark: objects, scenes, words and marks drawn by the pen from their seeds as inline SVG, with line boil and draw-on.
descriptions.font-inline: Naïve Indie Inline and its Fill, embedded in one stylesheet: import it once (@import "./fineliner/styles/inline.generated.css") to letter with <Lettering face="inline">.
descriptions.font-tramline: Naïve Indie Tramline, embedded in one stylesheet: import it once (@import "./fineliner/styles/tramline.generated.css") to letter with <Lettering face="tramline">.
descriptions.drawing-skill: A skill for your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex and others): it draws new objects, people and scenes for your project in the pen's style, registers them from your own module, and renders them large to check them. Installs into .claude/skills and .agents/skills.
descriptions.fineliner: Every part of Fineliner: the base, the pen engine and every component. Blocks are sample pages, so they install one at a time.
descriptions.chart: Recharts drawn with the page's one pen: drawnBar, drawnCurve, drawnDot and drawnSector draw strokes through the exact data points, and series are told apart by solid, outline, dotted and lined marks rather than colour.
descriptions.use-highlighted-code: useHighlightedCode: Shiki loaded lazily, one grammar at a time, with tokens mapped to one pen (bold keywords, italic strings, quiet comments) for CodeBlock.
descriptions.sign-in-01: Sign in with email and password or a link by email, beside a scene drawn by the pen; errors in the correction pen.
descriptions.dashboard-01: The shop's week: four figures in the typewriter, guests by day drawn by the pen, the records on hold and the next sessions.
descriptions.pricing-01: Three memberships on hanging price tags, a monthly or yearly segmented control, ticked features and questions in an accordion.
descriptions.empty-01: Empty states with drawings: a first run, no search results and nothing booked, each with one action.
descriptions.label-card: A label from a bottle or a sleeve: a drawing inside a drawn border, a lettered title, a kicker and spine text set bottom to top.
descriptions.record-sleeve: A square record sleeve: a drawing on the front, the title lettered, the catalogue number on the spine and the record's edge peeking out.
descriptions.track-list: Side A and side B: numbers and durations in the typewriter, titles in the reading face, dotted leaders, the playing track marked by the pen.
descriptions.tasting-note: A wine on the list: name and producer, grape, region and year in the typewriter, the note in the hand voice, the price and a drawing.
descriptions.price-tag: A hanging price tag: a drawn tag with a punched hole and string, the price in the typewriter, an old price struck through by the pen.
descriptions.hand-note: An aside in the hand voice with a drawn arrow toward what it is about, in the margin on wide screens and under its line on phones.
descriptions.edition-number: An edition number, Nº 0412, in the typewriter, optionally of a total, or set on the spine.
descriptions.drawn-border: The label's border round a region: four pen strokes that run past or stop short of their corners, optionally doubled, in CSS.
descriptions.room-header: A page head: a scene drawn by the pen with the title lettered beside or under it, drawn on the first time it is seen.
descriptions.pull-quote: A quote set large in the reading face against a pen rule, its quotation marks drawn by the pen.
descriptions.reading-progress: A pen line along the top of the page that draws itself as the reader scrolls an article.
descriptions.appearance-control: Every appearance setting (light, paper, pen, hand, line boil, containers, labels, density) as segmented controls and pen swatches.
descriptions.settings-01: A narrow settings column: profile, every appearance setting through AppearanceControl, notifications as switches, and closing the account behind an alert dialog.
descriptions.article-01: A journal post: a lettered RoomHeader with the issue's EditionNumber, prose in Typography with a drop cap, a PullQuote, a HandNote in the margin and ReadingProgress.
descriptions.hero-01: A lettered wordmark beside a scene the visitor can reroll, one line of copy, the install command in a code block and two actions.
